text:
Most visitors leave Osaka Station for dinner.
The best cheap eats are inside the buildings 👇

☕ Breakfast
Umeda Coffee-kan YC, since 1968.
Open 7:00 every day. Cash only.

🦑 Snack
Hanshin B1 ikayaki: squid in a thin pancake.
The shop once sold 10,000 in one day.

🍜 Weekday lunch
Ekimae Building basements:
Udon Bou, or set lunches at Iwamura.
Many shops there shut on Sundays.

🍛 Late
Spice curry at Kyu Yamu Tetsudo,
LUCUA B2, until 23:00.

👉 The 1950 alley under the tracks + all 7 picks:
https://japanbystation.com/food-near-osaka-umeda-station

Ikayaki or spice curry: what's first?
